title: Contributor Review Matrix and RFC Retirement Flow
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a unified contributor review matrix and an RFC retirement (sunset) flow that covers tokens, atomic components (buttons, inputs), complex components (tables, charts), and documentation. Deliverables: 1) a review matrix that prescribes reviewer types (design owner, accessibility SME, platform engineer, product owner) by change class, 2) an RFC lifecycle diagram with gates (intake, spec review, implementation, monitoring, retirement), 3) a deprecation timeline template (notice window, migration guidance, enforcement), and 4) an automated checklist to embed in PR templates and the Design Registry. Scope: all design-owned components and tokens, interactions with platform engineering for breaking API changes, and guidance for community contributors. Out of scope: infra-only changes that do not affect component surface area or token interfaces.
acceptance_criteria: 1) A downloadable PDF and Confluence page describing the review matrix and RFC retirement flow. 2) Example workflows for token change, minor visual tweak, and major API-breaking refactor. 3) PR templates updated with the auto-checklist and links. 4) At least one pilot RFC and one pilot deprecation executed end-to-end (token rename + component fallback). 5) Stakeholder sign-off from Design, Platform Eng, and Product.
notes: We want a practical flow that reduces back-and-forth for trivial cosmetic changes while preserving rigorous review for API and token-level changes that affect hosted customers. Emphasize migration guides and automatic warnings in the Design Registry. Consider adding a compatibility score (green/yellow/red) used in rollouts.
